title: Manual XGBoost FS+HP tuning run — nasdaq100 +10%/25d/dd5% (H=25)
purpose: Human XGBoost tuning reference + probe which XGBoost knobs move the metric on our panels, to inform the agent-loop decision schema (esp. #184) before extending the agent loop.
method: single-fit-per-iteration (max_iterations:1), analyst edits hp_starting between fits; #181 feature-matrix cache reused across iters (1.3s load vs ~31min build).

feature_selection.mechanism: algorithmic fs_hp_loop (max_iter 3) on best HP base
feature_selection.verdict: exactly neutral (bit-identical val Brier; model self-prunes). nasdaq H=25 = FS-neutral side (like _147); contrast nifty500 _176 where 279->39 helped. FS-helpfulness is cell-dependent.
feature_selection.top_features_theme: market-regime signature: parkinson/garman_klass/realized_vol estimators, index_return/runup/drawdown/vol, beta_*, vol cross-sectional z-scores, seasonality (moy_sin/cos) — not stock-specific momentum

interaction_constraints.reason: TreeSHAP pred_interactions pass exceeds diagnose time budget on the 279-feature US slice; effect predictably neutral on an HP-ceiling/test-invariant cell.
interaction_constraints.evidence_cited: _175 (Phase 8) verified the capability on the sister _147 cell — forbidding the top pair collapsed SHAP interaction->0 and tree co-occurrence 58.94->0 (honored), neutral metric effect.

findings.hp_ceiling: val Brier in a 0.6% band (0.16859-0.16967) across depth{4,6,8} x lambda{1.5,3,6} x colsample{0.8,1} x subsample{0.8,1} x min_child_weight{1,10} x gamma{0,1}
findings.val_optimal_neq_generalization_optimal: capacity+reg control train-val gap (0.0016-0.0146) and calib Z (6.3-13.0) at ~constant val Brier; d4/l6/mcw10 cleanest
findings.test_hp_invariant: eval AUC ~0.63 / test AUC ~0.49 across every config — eval->test decay is a regime/data property (corroborates #93), unmovable by tuning
findings.fs_neutral: model self-prunes to 98/279; algorithmic FS bit-identical

agent_loop_lessons: L1: break val-Brier ties with train-val gap + Spiegelhalter Z (a val-only loop can't distinguish d4/l6 gap0.0016 from d8/l3 gap0.0146 at equal val Brier).
L2: add min_child_weight to the XGBoost knob set — the only distinct knob to (marginally) improve val Brier here; not currently swept.
L3: the algorithmic FS is safe (bit-identical when unhelpful), so keep it; but it's cell-dependent (helpful on nifty500, neutral here/_147).
Meta: on HP-ceiling cells recognize the plateau + stop early (the plateau gate does); do NOT chase test generalization via HP — it's a regime property.
verdict_note: User's read (no automated PASS/FAIL). Run achieved its purpose: knob-sensitivity map + 3 actionable agent-loop upgrades. Cell is test-marginal (regime-decay, per #93) -> not a production candidate, but a sound controlled probe. n=1 cell.
